# Test data: arrays read out of a LIVE PETSc factored Mat, not hand-written.
#
#   PETSc v3.25.4, commit ab79ce791859c84e6d524d329ee8a429d6dc37ad
#   built PETSC_ARCH=arch-gh200-opt (real/double, 32-bit PetscInt, --with-debugging=0)
#
# Produced by a throwaway PETSc driver that, for a 4x3x2 seven-point star Laplacian
# (diagonal 6, off-diagonals -1) assembled with MatSetValues into a MATSEQAIJ:
#
#   MatGetOrdering(A, <natural|rcm>, &rperm, &cperm)
#   MatGetFactor(A, MATSOLVERPETSC, MAT_FACTOR_ILU, &F)
#   MatFactorInfoInitialize(&info); info.levels = 0; info.fill = 1.0
#   MatILUFactorSymbolic(F, A, rperm, cperm, &info)
#   MatLUFactorNumeric(F, A, &info)
#   MatSolve(F, b, x)                       with b[i] = 1 + sin(i+1)
#
# then printed, from the private Mat_SeqAIJ struct of A and F:
#   A_i/A_j/A_a  = the unfactored CSR
#   F_i          = a->i      (L row starts; L's unit diagonal is NOT stored)
#   F_diag       = a->diag   (U diagonal positions; strictly DECREASING)
#   F_j/F_a      = a->j/a->a (the packed L+U column indices and values)
#   F_r/F_c      = a->row/a->col (the row and column permutations MatSolve applies)
#   inode_size_csr = whether PETSc chose the Inode solve variant (0 = it did not)
#   rhs/sol      = the right-hand side and MatSolve_SeqAIJ's own output
#
# Field layout: a line '<name> <count>', then <count> whitespace-separated values.
# Two blocks, introduced by 'ordering natural' and 'ordering rcm'; the profiled ex45
# run used rcm, and natural is kept because it makes both permutations the identity --
# the case that would hide a permutation bug.
ordering natural
